en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. al-Saqr al-Sa’igh narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Ayyub narrated to us. He said: Ibrahim b. Musa informed us. He said: Hisham b. Yusuf informed us from `Abdullah b. Sulayman al-Nawfali from Muhammad b. `Ali b. `Abdullah b. `Abbas from his father from Ibn `Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
Love Allah when He nurtures you with His blessings. Love me for the sake of Allah’s love. Love my Ahl al-Bayt for the sake of my love.
